_comment: Central test-account data. No credentials live in code. Gmail '+' aliases all deliver to trimiotest@gmail.com and follow Trimio's users-table convention trimiotest+<role><n>@gmail.com.
_passwordPolicyNote: genericPassword must satisfy the REDESIGNED signup policy (8+ chars, upper+lower+digit+special, NO sequential digits like 123). The old 'Trimio@1234' is now rejected client-side because of the '1234' sequence.

verifiedAccount._comment: Pre-provisioned VERIFIED account used by the positive login / forgot-password / quality tests. Postgres user 41501 ('Casey Client'), active + email_verified_at set, seeded by backend/scripts/seed_login_pair.js. This USED to be user 948 / trimiotest+verified@gmail.com, which no longer exists in the database -- every positive login test then failed at 'login_button' against an account the backend had never heard of. Keep this in step with roleAccounts.client: they are the same person, and the password is bcrypt-verified server-side now, so a stale value fails rather than being ignored.

_roleAccountsNote: Per-role sign-ins for the signed-in mobile and web suites. The app routes by user_type_id (1 client, 2 professional, 3 admin, 4 support, 9 vendor), so each role needs its own seeded account. Leave an entry blank and every test that needs it SKIPS with an explanatory message instead of failing. The 'professional' account must have an APPROVED profile, otherwise the app reroutes to ProfessionalNotCreatedHomePage and the dashboard is unreachable.

client._comment: Postgres user 41501 ('Casey Client'), seeded by backend/scripts/seed_login_pair.js. Has a user_profile + address (Dallas, TX) AND a real Stripe TEST card (pm_card_visa) in client_payment_methods -- without the card the booking flow reaches 'Review & pay' and the charge is refused 402. Passwords are bcrypt now, not SHA-256.

professional._comment: Postgres user 41504 = professional_id 878 ('Pat Pro'), Class A Barber (TX), approved, on duty, 5 priced services. NOTE: its professional_stripe_accounts row is a FABRICATED 'acct_SEEDED_NOT_REAL_878', so it can be dispatched and booked but CANNOT TAKE MONEY -- resolveChargeAccount refuses a non-Stripe-issued id in every environment. Point this at a Connect-onboarded pro for the payment test.

admin._comment: Postgres user 41505, user_type_id = 3. Used by the admin console suite and by the professional-approval test (ADM-011): approval is an ADMIN action, so the test performs it through the console rather than writing approval_status directly.

vendor._comment: Postgres user 41506, user_type_id = 9 with a store_vendors row, seeded by seed_login_pair.js.

support._comment: user_type_id = 4. Permitted in the web portal but has no dedicated shell yet.

_storeFixturesNote: Names of seeded catalogue items used by the store visibility assertions. Leave blank to skip those tests.
